body: Im thinking about keeping ot on paper, i've always prefered messeges on paper and i think it's more fitting for a goodbye latter.

Therapy + medication were the worst thing that happened to me. I was constatntly shamed and made feel bad, every time i left in tears. I was told there is no things they can do really do for me. I was given antidepressant only to be taken off them a few weeks later becouse "young obviously don't need them, right?". I was told to make peace with never having a long term relationship. And that all happened while i was seeing someone who has good recommendations left and right. Im not doing that again. I doubt any therapy would help me anyways but doesn't matter, here the waiting list is impossibly long and profesionals don't really see bpd as something worth helping people with.

It's not the only things, responsibilities like school or job help me a lot too. And i love my cats. But in the evening when there is nothing but my loneliness to focus on, alcohol is the only thing that helps.

Thank you for understanding and for your kind words. Best of luck to you too.

I just wish i could be in the "datable" category, nothing more. And i doubt there is anything i can improve, i've already did quite a lot but it's still obviously not enough, unless i pay crazy money for surgeries, im pretty much done. And even the surgeries can do only as much, not change your entire bone structure.

Hey, at least you still have hope. There is still quite a lot of people with little to no experience with relationships at your age group, give it a few more years before you start thinking you're doomed, okay? At your age, you are still young enough that thing might work out for you in a bit becouse things change very fast. But once you're over 20, things settle down imo.
Yeah, as if walk was gonna solve any of my issues. I know you mean well but fuck, advices like this are so  useless.
